name: Expand
description: Collapsible component for expanding hidden sections.

notes: The trigger publishes aria-expanded and aria-controls referencing the content panel's id, matching the ARIA disclosure pattern
Keyboard navigation with Tab and Enter/Space
The content panel is aria-hidden while collapsed

contract.element: div containing disclosure button and content panel
contract.nativeProps: Div attributes/events go to the root. Trigger props/events go to its native button; Content props go to the outer collapsing div.
contract.state: state.expanded is controlled; onExpandedChange reports toggles. expanded is the legacy uncontrolled initial value, not controlled. defaultExpanded and isExpanded remain compatibility aliases; do not use them as controlled props.
contract.layout: String trigger children/title receive built-in title/icon layout. Element children without title switch to consumer-owned trigger layout and padding. Vertical padding on content.inner prevents a full collapse; pad a child instead.
contract.composition: Preset mode uses title plus body children. Compound mode uses Trigger and Content; with custom element children include Expand.Icon explicitly. Put a navigation link beside an icon-only Trigger rather than nesting a link in a button.
contract.accessibility: Trigger publishes aria-expanded and aria-controls. Custom icon-only triggers need aria-label. Contained layout removes trigger radius; match enclosing inner corners deliberately if clipping a focus ring.

Trigger.nativeProps: Button attributes/events are composed with disclosure press behavior.
Trigger.composition: Element children own layout and must include Expand.Icon if wanted; plain text gets a generated icon.

Content.element: div around an inner content wrapper
Content.nativeProps: Div attributes/events target the collapsing panel.
Content.layout: Keep the collapsing inner wrapper free of vertical padding; pad a child for spacing.

examples.name: Controlled disclosure
examples.description: Keep expansion controlled and explicitly compose a custom trigger.
